title: Themed
subtitle: 以某主題為基礎的；主題式的
description: 以某主題為基礎的；主題式的

words.meaning: 以某主題為基礎的；主題式的
words.note: theme-based 是 themed 最直接、最中性的近義說法之一，表示活動、課程、設計或內容以某個共同主題為基礎。
words.example: The school runs theme-based activities during the summer.
words.exampleZh: 學校在暑假舉辦主題式活動。

exercises.original: The museum offers themed workshops in which every activity relates to space exploration.
exercises.zh: 博物館提供主題式工作坊，所有活動都與太空探索有關。
exercises.upgrade: theme-based · 以某主題為基礎的；主題式的

options.explanation: decorated = 裝飾過的。只表示外觀，不代表所有活動都圍繞同一主題。
theme-based = 以主題為基礎的。every activity relates to space exploration 是直接線索。
unrelated = 無關的。和所有活動有共同主題相反。
generic = 一般性的。沒有特定主題。
seasonal = 季節性的。主題未必和季節有關。
random = 隨機的。和有統一主題相反。

exercises.original: The website groups its lessons into themed units such as travel, food, and technology.
exercises.zh: 網站把課程分成旅遊、食物和科技等主題單元。
exercises.upgrade: theme-based · 以某主題為基礎的；主題式的

options.explanation: decorative = 裝飾性的。不是內容分類方式。
generic = 一般性的。和明確主題分類不符。
seasonal = 季節性的。travel, food, technology 不是季節。
topic-free = 無主題的。語義相反。
theme-based = 主題式的。units organised by travel, food, technology 是典型。
randomised = 隨機化的。和按主題分組相反。

exercises.original: The camp has a themed programme this week, with all games linked to ancient Egypt.
exercises.zh: 營地本週有主題式活動，所有遊戲都與古埃及有關。
exercises.upgrade: theme-based · 以某主題為基礎的；主題式的

options.explanation: theme-based = 以主題為基礎的。all games linked to ancient Egypt 明確表示統一主題。
ordinary = 普通的。不能表達主題設計。
generic = 一般性的。和 ancient Egypt 主題不符。
unstructured = 無結構的。題目反而有清晰主題。
seasonal only = 只屬季節性。和古埃及無關。
unrelated = 無關的。語義相反。

words.note: 當 themed 強調整個空間、活動、產品或體驗從一開始便按某個主題來設計，可用 designed around a theme。
words.example: The restaurant is designed around a 1950s theme.
words.exampleZh: 這間餐廳圍繞1950年代主題設計。

exercises.original: The hotel is themed around the idea of ocean travel, from the rooms to the restaurant menus.
exercises.zh: 這間酒店從房間到餐牌都圍繞海上旅行主題設計。
exercises.upgrade: designed around a theme · 圍繞某個主題設計的

options.explanation: loosely decorated = 隨意裝飾。沒有整體主題設計意味。
unrelated to a theme = 與主題無關。語義相反。
based on location only = 只基於地點。題目說的是 ocean travel 概念。
designed around a theme = 圍繞主題設計。rooms + menus 都統一配合主題，是最精準。
generic in style = 風格一般。和主題化相反。
randomly arranged = 隨機安排。也相反。

exercises.original: The children's café is themed, with furniture, music, and food all planned around a jungle idea.
exercises.zh: 這間兒童咖啡店有明確主題，家具、音樂和食物都圍繞叢林概念設計。
exercises.upgrade: designed around a theme · 圍繞某個主題設計的

options.explanation: decorated only = 只是裝飾。題目還包括音樂和食物，不只是視覺。
theme-free = 無主題。語義相反。
designed around a theme = 圍繞主題設計。furniture, music, food 全面配合，是典型。
seasonal = 季節性。沒有季節線索。
generic = 一般。不是主題化。
uncoordinated = 不協調。和統一規劃相反。

exercises.original: The exhibition is themed around migration, and every room explores a different part of that idea.
exercises.zh: 展覽圍繞移民主題設計，每個展室探索這個主題的不同面向。
exercises.upgrade: designed around a theme · 圍繞某個主題設計的

options.explanation: randomly arranged = 隨機安排。與系統主題相反。
decorated for colour = 只為色彩裝飾。不能解釋內容安排。
generic = 一般性的。沒有主題。
seasonal = 季節性的。migration 在這裡不是季節主題。
topic-free = 無主題。相反。
designed around a theme = 圍繞主題設計。every room explores part of the same idea 是直接線索。

words.meaning: 以某主題為核心構成的
words.note: built around a theme 強調內容、體驗、活動或整體結構以某個主題作核心，再把其他元素組織在周圍。比單純裝飾更深入。
words.example: The festival is built around a theme of local food and culture.
words.exampleZh: 這個節慶以本地飲食和文化為核心主題。

exercises.original: The festival is themed around local history, with talks, performances, and food all connected to the town's past.
exercises.zh: 節慶以本地歷史為主題核心，講座、表演和食物都與小鎮過去有關。
exercises.upgrade: built around a theme · 以某主題為核心構成的

options.explanation: built around a theme = 以主題為核心構成。talks, performances, food 全部圍繞 local history，是典型整體結構。
decorated only = 只做裝飾。題目涉及活動內容。
randomly organised = 隨機組織。相反。
generic = 一般性的。沒有主題核心。
seasonal only = 只屬季節性。不是重點。
unrelated = 無關的。和 all connected 相反。

exercises.original: The course is themed around sustainability, so each project examines a different environmental challenge.
exercises.zh: 這門課以可持續發展為核心主題，每個項目研究不同環境挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: built around a theme · 以某主題為核心構成的

options.explanation: topic-free = 無主題。相反。
built around a theme = 以主題為核心構成。each project develops one aspect of sustainability，正是課程結構。
decorative = 裝飾性的。課程內容不是裝飾。
generic = 一般性的。和清楚 sustainability 主題不符。
random = 隨機。相反。
seasonal = 季節性的。不是這裡的意思。

exercises.original: The escape room is themed around a lost-laboratory story, and every puzzle contributes to the same narrative.
exercises.zh: 密室遊戲以失落實驗室故事為核心，每個謎題都服務同一敘事。
exercises.upgrade: built around a theme · 以某主題為核心構成的

options.explanation: built around a theme = 以主題為核心構成。every puzzle contributes to the same narrative，顯示主題深入整體結構。
decorated casually = 隨意裝飾。太表面。
generic = 一般性。沒有故事核心。
unrelated = 無關。和 same narrative 相反。
randomised = 隨機化。相反。
plain = 樸素。無關。

words.meaning: 以某主題為中心；聚焦某主題
words.note: 當 themed 強調內容、討論、活動或展覽聚焦於一個中心主題，可用 centred on a theme（美式可寫 centered）。它比設計語感更偏內容焦點。
words.example: The discussion was centred on a theme of social responsibility.
words.exampleZh: 討論以社會責任為中心主題。

exercises.original: The conference is themed around artificial intelligence and its impact on work.
exercises.zh: 會議以人工智能及其對工作的影響為中心主題。
exercises.upgrade: centred on a theme · 以某主題為中心；聚焦某主題

options.explanation: decorated around = 圍繞裝飾。會議重點是內容，不是裝潢。
generic = 一般性的。和明確主題相反。
centred on a theme = 以主題為中心。conference content + AI impact 是典型焦點用法。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。
randomly arranged = 隨機安排。相反。
unfocused = 無焦點。和明確主題相反。

exercises.original: The lecture series is themed around memory, identity, and how the two interact.
exercises.zh: 講座系列以記憶、身份認同及兩者互動為中心主題。
exercises.upgrade: centred on a theme · 以某主題為中心；聚焦某主題

options.explanation: built for decoration = 為裝飾而設。不是內容焦點。
generic = 一般性。不是主題化。
unstructured = 無結構。沒有支持。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。
theme-free = 無主題。相反。
centred on a theme = 以主題為中心。lecture series + conceptual focus 是非常自然。

exercises.original: This year's reading list is themed around journeys, both physical and emotional.
exercises.zh: 今年閱讀清單以旅程為主題，包括身體上的旅程和情感上的旅程。
exercises.upgrade: centred on a theme · 以某主題為中心；聚焦某主題

options.explanation: decorated = 裝飾。閱讀清單不是視覺裝飾。
built physically = 實體建造。完全不合。
random = 隨機。和統一閱讀主題相反。
centred on a theme = 聚焦主題。reading list + conceptual journeys 是典型。
generic = 一般。相反。
seasonal = 季節性。沒有季節線索。

words.meaning: 圍繞某主題組織安排的
words.note: 當 themed 強調多個部分、活動、單元或內容按照同一主題來分組、排列或安排時，可用 organised around a theme。
words.example: The lessons are organised around a theme of travel.
words.exampleZh: 課堂內容圍繞旅遊主題組織。

exercises.original: The textbook is themed, with each chapter grouped around topics such as family, travel, and work.
exercises.zh: 教科書採主題式編排，每章按家庭、旅遊和工作等主題組織。
exercises.upgrade: organised around a theme · 圍繞某主題組織安排的

options.explanation: generic = 一般。沒有主題分類意味。
organised around a theme = 圍繞主題組織。chapters grouped by family, travel, work 是直接線索。
decorated = 裝飾。和章節結構不同。
randomised = 隨機化。相反。
unrelated = 無關。相反。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。

exercises.original: The event is themed around community health, with separate sessions on food, exercise, and sleep.
exercises.zh: 活動圍繞社區健康主題安排，並分為飲食、運動和睡眠不同場次。
exercises.upgrade: organised around a theme · 圍繞某主題組織安排的

options.explanation: organised around a theme = 圍繞主題組織。separate sessions all linked to community health 是典型。
generic = 一般性。相反。
decorative = 裝飾性的。活動分場不是裝飾。
random = 隨機。相反。
theme-free = 無主題。相反。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。

exercises.original: The exhibition is themed so that photographs, objects, and interviews are grouped by the same central idea.
exercises.zh: 展覽採主題式編排，把照片、物件和訪談按同一中心概念分組。
exercises.upgrade: organised around a theme · 圍繞某主題組織安排的

options.explanation: decorated to match = 按主題裝飾。只說視覺，不足以描述內容分組。
generic = 一般性。相反。
unstructured = 無結構。和 grouped 相反。
randomised = 隨機安排。相反。
organised around a theme = 圍繞主題組織。grouped by the same central idea 是直接定義。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。

words.note: 當 themed 不表示所有元素嚴格依照同一主題，而是設計、菜式、服裝或活動從某個概念取得靈感時，可用 inspired by a theme。語氣較鬆、較創意。
words.example: The collection is inspired by a theme of desert landscapes.
words.exampleZh: 這個系列的靈感來自沙漠景觀主題。

exercises.original: The restaurant serves themed desserts loosely based on classic fairy tales.
exercises.zh: 餐廳供應受經典童話主題啟發的甜點，並非每款都完全照搬故事。
exercises.upgrade: inspired by a theme · 受某主題啟發的

options.explanation: generic = 一般性。沒有童話靈感。
decorated only = 只是裝飾。題目說 loosely based on，可能涉及造型和概念。
unrelated = 無關。相反。
seasonal = 季節性。無季節線索。
random = 隨機。相反。
inspired by a theme = 受主題啟發。loosely based on classic fairy tales 是最直接線索。

exercises.original: Her themed clothing collection uses colours and shapes taken from ocean life.
exercises.zh: 她的服裝系列受海洋生物主題啟發，採用相關色彩和形狀。
exercises.upgrade: inspired by a theme · 受某主題啟發的

options.explanation: generic = 一般性。沒有特定概念。
random = 隨機。和取材自 ocean life 相反。
inspired by a theme = 受主題啟發。colours and shapes taken from ocean life 是典型創作靈感。
theme-free = 無主題。相反。
strictly copied = 完全照搬。題目只說取材，不代表複製。
unrelated = 無關。相反。

exercises.original: The wedding had a themed look inspired by autumn forests rather than following a strict set of rules.
exercises.zh: 婚禮造型受秋季森林主題啟發，而不是嚴格按照固定規則。
exercises.upgrade: inspired by a theme · 受某主題啟發的

options.explanation: designed rigidly = 嚴格設計。和 rather than strict rules 相反。
generic = 一般性。沒有秋季森林概念。
seasonal only = 只是季節性。秋季元素在這裡是創意主題。
inspired by a theme = 受主題啟發。not strict + autumn forest inspiration 是決定性線索。
unplanned = 沒有計劃。並非如此。
unrelated = 無關。相反。

words.meaning: 按某主題裝飾的；裝飾成某種主題風格
words.note: 當 themed 主要指房間、餐廳、派對或場地的視覺裝飾符合某個主題時，可用 decorated to match a theme。它比 designed around a theme 更窄，只聚焦裝飾外觀。
words.example: The room was decorated to match a tropical theme.

exercises.original: The party room was themed with pirate flags, treasure chests, and rope decorations.
exercises.zh: 派對房間以海盜旗、寶箱和繩索作主題裝飾。
exercises.upgrade: decorated to match a theme · 按某主題裝飾的；裝飾成某種主題風格

options.explanation: organised around content = 按內容組織。派對房間重點是視覺裝飾。
decorated to match a theme = 按主題裝飾。flags, treasure chests, rope decorations 是直接視覺線索。
generic = 一般。相反。
unrelated = 無關。相反。
theme-free = 無主題。相反。
randomly furnished = 隨意佈置。和統一海盜風格相反。

exercises.original: The café is themed like an old railway station, with clocks, signs, and vintage luggage on the walls.
exercises.zh: 咖啡店裝飾成舊火車站主題，牆上有時鐘、標誌和復古行李。
exercises.upgrade: decorated to match a theme · 按某主題裝飾的；裝飾成某種主題風格

options.explanation: generic = 一般。沒有特色主題。
unstructured = 無結構。不是裝飾描述。
random = 隨機。相反。
theme-free = 無主題。相反。
decorated to match a theme = 按主題裝飾。clocks, signs, vintage luggage 都是視覺佈置。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。

exercises.original: Each bedroom is themed differently, using matching colours, wall art, and furniture.
exercises.zh: 每間睡房都有不同主題，以配合的顏色、牆畫和家具作裝飾。
exercises.upgrade: decorated to match a theme · 按某主題裝飾的；裝飾成某種主題風格

options.explanation: inspired loosely only = 只是受啟發。題目說 matching colours, wall art, furniture，顯示更完整配合。
decorated to match a theme = 按主題裝飾。視覺元素一致，是最精準。
organised by topic = 按主題內容組織。房間不是內容單元。
generic = 一般。相反。
randomised = 隨機。相反。
theme-free = 無主題。相反。

words.meaning: 以某主題為基礎的；根據某主題構思的
words.note: based on a theme 是非常自然的廣泛改寫，適合遊戲、故事、派對、活動、菜單、設計等。它比 theme-based 更像句子層級的改寫。
words.example: The game is based on a theme of space exploration.
words.exampleZh: 這個遊戲以太空探索為主題構思。

exercises.original: The quiz is themed around famous inventions from the nineteenth century.
exercises.zh: 這個問答遊戲以十九世紀著名發明為主題。
exercises.upgrade: based on a theme · 以某主題為基礎的；根據某主題構思的

options.explanation: random = 隨機。和特定主題相反。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。
based on a theme = 以主題為基礎。quiz questions all relate to famous inventions，最自然。
generic = 一般性。沒有特定主題。
unrelated = 無關。相反。
theme-free = 無主題。相反。

exercises.original: The children's menu is themed around animals, with each dish named after a different creature.
exercises.zh: 兒童餐牌以動物為主題，每道菜都以不同動物命名。
exercises.upgrade: based on a theme · 以某主題為基礎的；根據某主題構思的

options.explanation: decorative only = 只做裝飾。菜名本身也配合主題。
generic = 一般性。相反。
random = 隨機。相反。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。
unrelated = 無關。相反。
based on a theme = 以主題為基礎。all dish names linked to animals 是直接線索。

exercises.original: The game night was themed around detective stories, and every challenge involved solving clues.
exercises.zh: 遊戲之夜以偵探故事為主題，每項挑戰都涉及破解線索。
exercises.upgrade: based on a theme · 以某主題為基礎的；根據某主題構思的

options.explanation: theme-free = 無主題。相反。
generic = 一般性。沒有偵探概念。
based on a theme = 以主題為基礎。every challenge involved clues，顯示整體建基於 detective theme。
random = 隨機。相反。
seasonal = 季節性。無關。
unrelated = 無關。相反。

falseSynonyms.zh: 主題；話題不等於一般的 themed topic 是主題本身；themed 是形容詞，表示某事物圍繞某個主題設計或安排。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A topic is the subject; themed describes something organised around a subject.

falseSynonyms.zh: 主題不等於一般的 themed theme 是名詞；themed 是形容詞。兩者意思相關但句法位置不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Theme is a noun; themed is an adjective.

falseSynonyms.zh: 裝飾過的不等於一般的 themed decorated 只表示有裝飾，不代表裝飾、內容和活動都圍繞同一主題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A room can be decorated without being themed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 季節性的不等於一般的 themed seasonal 表示和某個季節或節日時期有關。很多 themed 活動不是 seasonal。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A Halloween-themed event may be seasonal, but a space-themed event is not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有格調的；時尚的不等於一般的 themed stylish 表示外觀時尚或有品味，並不表示有統一主題。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A stylish restaurant may have no specific theme.

falseSynonyms.zh: 協調一致的不等於一般的 themed coordinated 表示元素彼此配合，但不一定由同一主題概念統一。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Colours can be coordinated without the design being themed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 品牌化的；帶品牌元素的不等於一般的 themed branded 表示使用特定品牌名稱、標誌或形象。品牌化設計可能有主題，但兩者不相同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A branded event promotes a brand; a themed event follows a concept.

falseSynonyms.zh: 與當前話題有關的；時事性的不等於一般的 themed topical 通常表示與當前話題、議題或某個 topic 有關，不等於『以一個主題設計』的 themed。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A topical discussion concerns a current issue; a themed event is organised around a concept.
